2122376058813182286.en_summary: It still amazes me what fear does to people’s math. Investors are piling into consumer staples at all time highs. $COST at 52x earnings, a RETAILER priced like a hypergrowth company. Meanwhile $GOOG trades at 15x, one of the greatest businesses ever built, compounding double digits with a fortress balance sheet. Paying 52x for single digit growth is not safety, it is paying a premium to hide.
2122376058813182286.zh_summary: 恐懼對人們數學的影響仍然讓我驚訝。投資者正在歷史新高時湧入消費必需品。$COST以52倍市盈率，一個零售商像高增長公司定價。與此同時$GOOG以15倍交易，有史以來最偉大的業務之一，以雙位數複合增長並有堡壘式資產負債表。為個位數增長支付52倍不是安全，而是支付溢價來隱藏。
